title: Replace a growing repeated-pair sum by seven fixed-variable point counts
statement: The eight moments at(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,0),(1,1),(1,2),(2,0),(2,1) recover signed joint-state masses. Seven become ordinary cubic Artin-Schreier point counts with at most8 field variables; the zeroth is binary Gaussian. Fixed-variable Lauder-Wan bounds give softO(d^31) time and softO(d^20) space.
